as_of.description: a Delta table: the newest version at or before this ISO-8601 time

dataset.description: a folder of table files: one table per file

fail_on_empty.description: fail instead of warning when a table has 0 rows

output.description: where to write the .shape profile (default: the jobs directory)

project.description: a shape.yml project file; its settings apply as for `--project FILE` (the bridge never looks for one on its own)

source.description: a file, folder, glob or Delta table

source_options.description: source options; Iceberg catalog and snapshot_id, credential references only

version.description: a Delta table: profile this version

async.description: for a command that can run as a job: return a job id at once and run in the background

include_raw_values.description: return raw values (minimum, maximum, category values, offending values) even for classified columns; off by default

max_inline_bytes.description: a result part larger than this is written to a file and returned as a reference
